name: Shuurou! Akuma de Company
original_name: 就労！アクマ・デ・カンパニー
source:
The main character started his first day working at the ultra-big company "Akuma de Company''.

Be a demon and work at the worst company!

[Translated from [url=https://samezaki.itch.io/demoncompany]Itch.io[/url]]
